_comment: Island bundle-size budgets, in gzipped kilobytes, measured BEYOND the
shared chunks every island already pays for (the React runtime and Astro's
renderer). Enforced by scripts/check-budgets.mjs, which runs in CI.
These numbers are the interactive contract from PLAN.md §3.3, not
aspirations. Raising one is a deliberate decision that belongs in a PR

overrides._comment: Islands allowed more than the default, with the reason why.

ConceptMap.why: React Flow, loaded on /map only and nowhere else (§1.3).

shared.why: React runtime plus Astro's client renderer. Every island pays this once, so it is budgeted separately rather than charged to each.
